**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/29 (Mon) 21:57
- [FACT] User requested information about clinical trials involving statins in combination with fenofibrate or ezetimibe.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There have been several clinical trials where statins were used in combination with either fenofibrate or ezetimibe.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] List of clinical trials provided by the assistant:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Trial 1: ACCORD Lipid Study (Action to Control Cardiovascular Risk in Diabetes)
    - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Combination: Statin (simvastatin) + fenofibrate
    - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Conclusion: The addition of fenofibrate to simvastatin did not significantly reduce the rate of fatal cardiovascular events, nonfatal myocardial infarction, or nonfatal stroke compared to simvastatin alone in patients with type 2 diabetes.
    - [ASSISTANT_SAID] DOI: 10.1056/NEJMoa1001282
    - [ASSISTANT_SAID] URL: <https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa1001282>
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Trial 2: IMPROVE-IT (IMProved Reduction of Outcomes: Vytorin Efficacy International Trial)
    - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Combination: Statin (simvastatin) + ezetimibe
    - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Conclusion: The combination of simvastatin and ezetimibe resulted in a significant reduction of cardiovascular events in patients with acute coronary syndromes when compared to simvastatin alone.
    - [ASSISTANT_SAID] DOI: 10.1056/NEJMoa1410489
    - [ASSISTANT_SAID] URL: <https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa1410489>
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Trial 3: FIELD study (Fenofibrate Intervention and Event Lowering in Diabetes)
    - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Combination: Statin (various) + fenofibrate
    - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Conclusion: Fenofibrate did not significantly reduce the risk of the primary outcome of coronary events in patients with type 2 diabetes, but it did reduce the rate of total cardiovascular events, mainly due to fewer non-fatal myocardial infarctions and revascularizations.
    - [ASSISTANT_SAID] DOI: 10.1016/S0140-6736(05)67667-2
    - [ASSISTANT_SAID] URL: <https
